utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where exactly is the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Right here on the block, at the community hall by Maple and Third. I’ll point you to the table when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks. I’ll head to the community hall at Maple and Third.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with that. What still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I need help checking supplies and getting more folks to pitch in. I’ll spread the word and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll check the supplies and bring more people in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. I’m checking the supply list now and setting aside anything we can spare for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still around if you need another hand with the drive, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got the supplies under control, but I may still take you up on that hand once I finish the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about Saturday morning? I might have mixed up the day, but that should give us time to get the repair drive set up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday morning works, but could you confirm the exact time and what part of the repair drive you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 9 should work for me, and I can handle setting out the tools and checking what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me. Where should we meet for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning works. Let’s meet at my place, and I’ll have the tools and pickup stuff ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, I’ll come by Saturday morning too. Just let me know the exact time when you have it set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll swing by after my errands and check what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll be grateful for the help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Uli. I’ll check what needs fixing after I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive's moving along. Gus said he'd swing by after errands to check on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't got the exact start time yet, but I can check on it while I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I heard it’s still short a few hands, so spreading the word would help. I can check on it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can do that. I’ll spread the word and check what else still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that should help. I’ll keep checking on it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, then bring any spare tools you can spare and a few hands if you know anyone who can pitch in today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I can bring spare tools and I’ll ask a couple neighbors to come lend a hand today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it’s still on, but I’m worried the timing and parts could still throw us off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, right? Just making sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the wiring and mounts. I’m here by the repair drive, so just bring what you have.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the wiring and mounts. I can help with whichever you want first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bo sent out a quick update: the repair drive shifted to Saturday, and we’re asking folks to sign up by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Saturday. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We could use you to help sort tools and check in with people for Thursday sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t got the latest yet, but I can check on the repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, I can help with whatever’s left. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t got the latest yet, but I can check on it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me. Where exactly is the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. I just need the address for drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I just need the address for drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll meet you by the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo. I’ll see you there and help with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa. What do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bring whatever tools you can spare, and I’ll make sure they get matched to the right repair job.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll bring what I can and keep an eye out for the right repair job.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you go over the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I have everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure - I’ll keep it simple: there’s a list of repair jobs, and each one gets matched with the right helper. Rosa has the list under control.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. What’s the next job on the list, and who needs the right helper?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds like the drive is really coming together. I’ll keep spreading the word and see if anyone else can chip in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep checking our supplies and set aside anything we can spare for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word and see who else can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting, and do you want me to help line up the fasteners, patch tape, and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on. I’m just trying to keep the numbers and materials straight so we don’t end up short.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can help with that. How many people are you thinking, and what time should I bring the materials?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard it’s moving along too. Gus said he’d swing by after errands to check on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is still on, right? Just checking I have that straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s right — the repair drive is still on, and Gus is checking it after errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can keep folks on the same page about it. What part of the repair drive needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can handle the coordination piece and keep everyone updated. What do you want me to pass along first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning sounds right to me, and I can bring that hammer over too if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d help a lot, Oren. Bring it by Saturday morning if you can, and I’ll make sure folks know we still need a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I just heard the update: the repair drive shifted to this Saturday, and we’re sorting the tool list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday works for me. What time are you starting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s meet at 9 a.m.; that gives us time to set up before the rush.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where exactly is the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Rosa said it’s at the repair drive list she organized, and she’ll make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, where’s the actual address for the drop-off?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
